title: Bridge 5722, Carries North Section Street (U.S. HIghway 63/Trunk Highway 1) over Spring Valley Creek, Spring Valley, Fillmore County, MN
notes: Significance: Bridge No. 5722 is an unusual engineering adaptation of the Minnesota Department of Highway's (MHD) standardized box culvert plan for use on a U. S. Highway to meet site-specific conditions normally accommodated by a bridge design. Built in 1936, Bridge No. 5722 is only one of three extant examples on U. S. Highways in Minnesota of a concrete box culvert design adapted by the MHD to function as a bridge and meet the requirements of both vehicular and pedestrian traffic.
